reviews.comment: She is okay, I would not recommend her for future classes. Her handwriting pretty bad, and her quizzes and test are definitely lecture heavy focus. She does not post her slides, takes attendance, her lectures are extremely monotone and it's hard to understand her. She dislikes AI and will find anyway to see if a student uses it on any assignment.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She doesn't know how to teach and if a topic isn't covered in class instead of doing it next class she makes you learn on your own. Also a poor lecturer you can barely understand what she saying or talking about. Answer keys are often wrong and your left scrambling just trying to understand content, highly do not recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are monotone and not helpful, but exams are not too tough as long as you can complete the homework.

Her lectures are extremely boring and she is very inefficient in teaching us the material - we were unable to cover a whole module this semester b/c of her going too slow through the material. Her exams are very reasonable however and HW's are good prep.

Paez is a solid professor! The homework load is very manageable, the exams were reasonable as far as difficulty. Her lectures are decent, and she does now post her annotated slides. The problems worked in class are quite similar to the exams.

She's very rude when you email her and in person and offers no help. Our TA carried and was super nice, but when it came to lectures Diana is very monotoned, mumbles, and is extremely boring. The only reason I attend lectures is because she refuses to post her lecture slides (why???) and she takes attendance daily. Do not recommend at all.

She has a quiet and monotone voice, so her lectures are hard to follow. Sign-in sheet passed around most to all classes. Homeworks are very long, but you are given an ample time to complete it. Homework feedback is felt unclear.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Paez is an all around bad professor. She is soft spoken and her lectures can easily put you to sleep. She is so incredibly monotone and makes fluids and hydrology sound like it is the most boring thing in the world. Her TA, Aya, was terrible. She takes off so many points off HWs for the pettiest of reasons. Avoid

Her class wasn't terrible but wasn't the best experience either. She doesn't upload her filled in notes after class so that you have to attend, mandatory sign in sheet (attendance is graded). Her quizzes can be iffy if you don't practice multiple types of unit conversions beforehand, just practice lecture problems before you attempt. Long HW.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Is a nice professor, but I had difficulty following her. Quizzes aren't too difficult if you can follow along in class, but her writing is difficult to read and it's easy to fall behind. She doesn't post her notes from lectures, so you need to take a lot of notes yourself, otherwise the only practice problems you have are from the book.

Professor Paez just doesn't make for a good outlet to learn fluid dynamics. Her lectures are hard to follow because of both how soft-spoken she is, and how illegible her handwriting is to read. The online quiz and final submission portions are irrationally mechanically complex for submissions. Try to take a different professor if you can.

The entire class is her copying down material that is already on her slides. She mumbles/whispers a lot which is easily confusing and expects you to know the most random unit conversions. She grades as nicely as she can but I just did not enjoy her teaching style or class whatsoever. She's OK but take someone else if you have a better option.
